criteria.detail: The verbatim brief's constraints state "Do not modify the project working tree; it may hold the wave's mid-wave work. Deliver the artifact in your reply. Run no git that changes the tree, and do not run git for any other purpose."; the plan's own PC5 (Tree discipline) repeats it.
The deliverable is the launch plan: the dispatch document (complete JSON, c2d preflight-passing), the verbatim brief, and binary pass criteria; no recitation of the procedure.

The brief forbids every account of the repair: incident report, motivating complaint, reasoning, plan/hand-back files, git diff, /nix/.cortex, and memory/incident/plan files in any .cortex tree; the actor's grounding reads were all under /opt/skills.
git status --porcelain before and after the run were identical (baseline untracked: .cortex/, .devcontainer/coding, spec/); no files written, no git run, artifact delivered in the reply.

Transcript scan for the incident slug, list_models, and the run id: zero hits. Reads limited to /opt/skills: catalyst-v2, self-testing, dispatch, running-a-meta-agent, writing-delegation-specs, testing, model-picking models.yaml.

judge_reasoning: Meta-agent evaluation against the pre-written criteria: PASS on all five. The replay derived the launch plan entirely from the live instructions under /opt/skills: the dispatch document (kind unit, omp, opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash, thinking max, cwd = the project repo, inline brief, heartbeat 900000, on_failure abort), the verbatim brief carrying the full constraint set, and binary pre-fixed pass criteria (PC1-PC8). Run no git that changes the tree, and do not run git for any other purpose.'
